description: This file contains the definition of the Customer model class within the Opencart admin module, implementing functions for managing customer data such as add, edit, delete, and retrieve customers and their related information.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Model class for handling customer data within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Inserts a new customer record into the database using the provided data array.

methods.name: editCustomer
methods.description: Updates an existing customer record identified by customer_id with new data.

methods.name: editToken
methods.description: Updates the customer's token in the database.

methods.name: editCommenter
methods.description: Sets whether the customer is a commenter (reply enabled/disabled).

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes the customer and all related data entries from multiple tables.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a customer by customer_id.

methods.name: getCustomerByEmail
methods.description: Fetches a customer's details based on their email address.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Gets a list of customers based on filter criteria, supports sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCustomers
methods.description: Returns the total number of customers matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByCustomerGroupId
methods.description: Returns total customer count for a specific customer group ID.

methods.name: deleteActivities
methods.description: Deletes all activity records for a specified customer.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Adds a new address for the specified customer, returning the address ID.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Updates an existing address for a customer identified by address_id.

methods.name: deleteAddresses
methods.description: Deletes one or all addresses associated with a customer, optionally a specific address by address_id.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves detailed address information, including country and zone data, for the given address_id.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves all addresses associated with a customer.

methods.name: getTotalAddresses
methods.description: Returns the total number of addresses for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalAddressesByCountryId
methods.description: Returns the total number of addresses for a specific country.

methods.name: getTotalAddressesByZoneId
methods.description: Returns the total number of addresses for a specific zone.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a history comment for a customer.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history comments for a customer.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves a list of history comments for a customer with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total number of history comments for a customer.

methods.name: deleteWishlists
methods.description: Deletes all wishlist entries for a customer.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Adds a financial transaction record for a customer.

methods.name: deleteTransactions
methods.description: Deletes all transaction records for a customer.

methods.name: deleteTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes transaction records linked to a specific order.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions for a customer with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTransactions
methods.description: Returns the total number of transactions for a customer.

methods.name: getTransactionTotal
methods.description: Calculates the sum of transaction amounts for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Returns the total count of transactions linked to a specific order.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Adds reward points for a customer, optionally linked to an order.

methods.name: deleteRewards
methods.description: Deletes all reward entries for a customer.

methods.name: deleteRewardsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes reward entries linked to a specific order.

methods.name: getRewards
methods.description: Retrieves reward entries for a customer with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalRewards
methods.description: Returns the total count of reward entries for a customer.

methods.name: getRewardTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total reward points accumulated by a customer.

methods.name: getTotalRewardsByOrderId
methods.description: Returns the total count of reward entries linked to a specific order.

methods.name: deleteIps
methods.description: Deletes all IP address records associated with a customer.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IP addresses associated with a customer with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalIps
methods.description: Returns the total number of IP address records for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByIp
methods.description: Returns the count of customers associated with a specific IP address.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByIp
methods.description: Returns the total number of customers linked to a given IP address.

methods.name: getTotalLoginAttempts
methods.description: Retrieves data about total login attempts for an email.

methods.name: deleteLoginAttempts
methods.description: Deletes login attempt records for an email.

methods.name: addAuthorize
methods.description: Adds an authorization record for a customer with token, IP, and user agent details.

methods.name: getAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Retrieves an authorization record by customer ID and token, including total attempts.

methods.name: getAuthorizes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of authorization records for a customer with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAuthorizes
methods.description: Returns the total number of authorization records for a customer.

methods.name: editAuthorizeStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an authorization record.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotal
methods.description: Updates the total field of an authorization record.

methods.name: resetAuthorizes
methods.description: Resets the total field of all authorization records for a customer to zero.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizes
methods.description: Deletes authorization records for a customer, optionally for a specific authorization ID.
